_howToUpdate: Registration dates now come live from CCB. Set the form's Start and End dates in CCB and the page follows them automatically.
Each course finds its CCB form by the ids in ccbFormIds, or by a form title containing any phrase in match. Name new CCB forms with the course name and they appear on their own with no edit here.
A form shows as OPEN when it is published, its status is Available, and today falls between its start and end dates. It drops off the day after its end date.
A published form with a future start date shows under Opening Soon.
Forms with no end date stay open for up to openEndedMaxDays after they start. Setting an end date in CCB is the better habit.
Add a form id to ignoreFormIds to keep a form off the page.
formDetails adds class info CCB does not store, keyed by form id: startDate (YYYY-MM-DD), schedule, format, label.
fallbackSessions are only used if the CCB connection is down. Keep them roughly current or leave them empty.
Preview any date by adding ?preview=2026-09-10 to the GitHub Pages URL.
